approxWhy: Lower than the truth: one fitting has no odometer reading. Correct it under “Fitting history” below.

assets.title: All registered tires
assets.searchPlaceholder: Brand, size, DOT, or truck plate
assets.empty: No tires registered yet. Tires are registered when fitted from a work order, or with “Register used tires already in the workshop”.

intake.open: Register used tires already in the workshop
intake.title: Register used tires already in the workshop
intake.subtitle: For used tires you already have that are not registered — so they can be fitted later. This is not receiving a shipment: new tires are recorded with “Receive stock”.
intake.km: Roughly how many km it has run (if known)
intake.nothing: Fill in at least one tire
intake.confirmBody: Each one is registered as a used tire in stock, ready to fit. The new-tire stock does not change. A tire registered by mistake can be deleted from its file.

form.dot: DOT code written on the tire (if any)
form.kmBad: Not a valid number — type a number up to 9,999,999

edit.title: Edit tire details
edit.subtitle: Correct what was typed wrong: brand, size, DOT, or the km it started with.
edit.baseKm: Km run before it was registered here
edit.baseKmHint: Leave zero for a new tire. This is added to what it has run since.

delete.title: Delete this tire from the records?
delete.body: It is removed with all its history. Use this only if it was registered by mistake — if the tire is finished, scrap it instead.
delete.bodyShipment: It is removed with all its history, and one tire goes back to the new-tire stock. Use this only if it was registered by mistake — if the tire is finished, scrap it instead.
delete.mounted: The tire is fitted, so it cannot be deleted. Take it off in a work order first, or if the fitting itself was a mistake press “Fitted by mistake” below.

life.heading: Change the tire's status
life.mountedFirst: The tire is fitted on a truck. To send it for repair or retreading, or to scrap it, take it off first in a work order for that truck.

sendRepair.label: Send for repair
sendRepair.title: Send the tire for repair?
sendRepair.body: It is recorded as out for repair and is not offered for fitting until you bring it back.
sendRepair.notePlaceholder: For example: where it went and what is wrong

backFromRepair.label: Back from repair
backFromRepair.title: Is the tire back from repair?
backFromRepair.body: It goes back to stock as a used tire ready to fit.
backFromRepair.notePlaceholder: For example: what was done and the cost

sendRetread.label: Send for retreading
sendRetread.title: Send the tire for retreading?
sendRetread.body: It is recorded as out for retreading and is not offered for fitting until you bring it back.

backFromRetread.label: Back from retreading
backFromRetread.title: Is the tire back from retreading?
backFromRetread.body: It goes back to stock ready to fit, and its retread count goes up by one.

scrap.label: Scrap it
scrap.title: Scrap this tire?
scrap.body: A scrapped tire cannot be fitted again and is not offered for fitting.
scrap.sure: Yes, this tire is finished and will not be fitted again

unscrap.label: Scrapped by mistake — return to stock
unscrap.title: Return the tire to stock?
unscrap.body: It becomes a used tire in stock, ready to fit. Use this if it was scrapped by mistake.

historyEmpty: This tire has not been fitted on a truck yet
kmRunUnknown: Distance not counted: a spare, or an odometer reading is missing.

editOdo.title: Correct odometer readings
editOdo.hint: The distance the tire ran is worked out from these two readings. A box left empty stays as it is.
editOdo.stillOn: The tire is still fitted, so there is no take-off reading yet.
editOdo.backwards: The take-off reading ({{dismounted}}) is lower than the fitting reading ({{mounted}}). An odometer does not go backwards — check both numbers.

reason.title: Why did the tire come off?
reason.body: The reason decides what happens to the tire after it comes off. Pick the right one.
reason.bodyNoFollow: Only the recorded reason is corrected. The tire's current status stays, because it was changed after the tire came off — change it under “Change the tire's status”.

undoDismount.open: It should not have come off — put it back
undoDismount.title: Put the tire back where it was?
undoDismount.body: The take-off is cancelled as if it never happened, and the tire is fitted again on {{plate}} in the same place. If another tire has been fitted there, that one has to come off first.
undoDismount.done: The tire is back in place
undoDismount.notPossible: The tire's status changed or it was fitted again after this take-off, so it cannot be put back from here.

undoMount.open: Fitted by mistake — cancel the fitting
undoMount.title: Cancel this fitting?
undoMount.bodyUsed: The fitting is cancelled as if it never happened, and the tire goes back to stock as a used tire ready to fit.
undoMount.bodyNew: The fitting is cancelled as if it never happened. This tire was new from stock: it goes back to the new-tire stock and this file is removed.
undoMount.bodyOnboard: The fitting is cancelled as if it never happened. This tire was registered only by this fitting, so its file is removed with it.

notFoundLong: This tire does not exist — it may have been deleted.
